description: Latest pins of a public Pinterest profile from Pinterest's own RSS feed: profile name and description, and for each of the newest 25 pins the pin URL and ID, text, image URL and publish date. Works for public profiles without login; boards, search and engagement counts are not part of the feed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
